# SchoolGrid — Multi-School Institutional Activity & Management Platform

> One Platform. Multiple Schools. Unified Management.
> SchoolGrid is a multi-tenant institutional SaaS platform enabling K-12 and senior secondary schools to manage academic wings, classes, faculty, students, programmes, achievements, notices, and public school websites with tenant-isolated data security.

## Primary Public URLs
- [Home & Sign-In](https://ms-school-grid.vercel.app/): Role-based login for SuperAdmin, School Admins, Teachers, and Students via Email/Password and Google OAuth.
- [Public Schools Directory](https://ms-school-grid.vercel.app/schools): Browse active institutions registered on SchoolGrid and visit their public portals.
- [Institutional Plans & Services](https://ms-school-grid.vercel.app/services): Compare transparent monthly, quarterly, and annual service plans with feature entitlements.
- [Register Your School](https://ms-school-grid.vercel.app/register-school): Submit a new institutional onboarding request for SuperAdmin review and atomic workspace provisioning.
- [Privacy Policy](https://ms-school-grid.vercel.app/privacy): Data privacy, Google OAuth & Google Drive handling, and student record protection standards.
- [Terms of Service](https://ms-school-grid.vercel.app/terms): Platform usage guidelines for schools, administrators, teachers, and students.

## Sample Public Institutional Portal
- [Greenwood International Academy](https://ms-school-grid.vercel.app/s/greenwood-academy): Live example of a school-owned public website showcasing active wings, public programmes, achievements, campus news, and official notices.

## Core Capabilities
- **Multi-Tenant Isolation**: Each school operates inside its own scoped workspace with composite tenant foreign keys and server-side RBAC.
- **Institutional Wings & Programmes**: Organize STEM, Cultural, Sports, and Club wings with draft-to-public publishing controls.
- **Real-Time Operations & Storage**: Live updates across classes, teachers, students, notices, and per-school Google Drive document linking.
- **Security & Governance**: Supabase Auth identity verification, Turso/libSQL multi-tenant database, hashed single-use invitations, and append-only audit logs.
